scenario.title: JASSY-KISHINEV OFFENSIVE - 20 AUG 1944
intro.text:
JASSY-KISHINEV OFFENSIVE - 20 AUG 1944

North of Jassy, Eastern Romania

In our major offensive on Romania you and your troops will be deployed on the right wing of the attack front. The goal is to encircle and destroy the enemy's 6th Army.

ORDERS
Capture all VH!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-briliant.text: Sevastopol fell and the coastal exits closed before the evacuation could become an orderly withdrawal. The harbour is ours, crowded with what the enemy failed to remove.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-victory.text: Sevastopol is liberated and most of the withdrawing force was trapped. A few ships carried away the formations we were hours too late to reach.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-tactical.text: Sevastopol is ours. More enemy troops got out by sea than we intended. I need the embarkation reports before I can say which formations escaped.
line.reaction-lose.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.reaction-lose.text: Sevastopol and the evacuation roads did not fall in time. The enemy escaped the peninsula with formations it can place in front of us again; Iași is where some of that account returns.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.callback-choice-a.text: Your coastal groups got behind the Sevastopol defenders. Headquarters expects us to close another ring here. I still need confirmation of the neighbouring armies' positions.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.callback-choice-b.text: We took Sevastopol before splitting the force. Ships left during the assault. Headquarters wants the troops trapped this time; it has asked me what we'll do differently.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.earned-decision.text: Sevastopol fell before the evacuation timetable could empty its workshops. The usable vehicles and returning assault cadres can support only one programme before Iași.
line.earned-decision.choice.use-crimean-: Use the recovered transport to rebuild the mobile supply columns.
Fully refuel and rearm the core and gain 80 prestige from recovered stores.
line.earned-decision.choice.retain-sevas: Keep the returning assault cadres as a naval-infantry detachment.
Add an experienced eight-strength naval-infantry detachment to the core.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.earned-a-response.text: Allocate the recovered transport to the supply columns. I'll check which vehicles the workshops can make serviceable before the attack.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.earned-b-response.text: Keep their officers with them. They can take the Sevastopol name into the new assignment; I'll explain to the replacements why it matters to the men.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: Use this map, not the deception copy. The breakthrough batteries are concealed and the mobile formations are still out of sight. Keep that disposition sheet in this room.
line.scene-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.scene-1.text: It's the Sixth Army again. Rebuilt under the same name. If we trap it, headquarters will want Stalingrad mentioned. Let's wait until the roads are actually closed.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: Once the line breaks, we can turn inward immediately to close the pocket, or drive west for crossings that may decide whether the encirclement remains sealed next week.
line.decision.choice.close-the-pocket.te: Turn the mobile group inward and close the ring before the Sixth Army can react.
line.decision.choice.close-the-pocket.hi: Fully refuel the core, give tank and reconnaissance formations 25 experience each, and gain 100 prestige for closing the pocket.
line.decision.choice.seize-the-crossings: Drive west for the river and road crossings while infantry compresses the pocket.
Attach an eight-strength 1943 engineer detachment with 50 experience and restore the core to eight strength with full supply; bridging stores cost 90 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: The mobile group turns on the first confirmed rupture. No pause for a perfect front line; neighbouring spearheads become the line when they meet.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-a-1.text: Then we depend on another army for the western crossings. Send liaison officers there now. I need their commander to confirm what he can hold.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: The mobile group takes the western crossings. Tell the following armies which exits we're closing; they'll have to compress the pocket without us.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-b-1.text: I'll keep tracking the columns inside the pocket. Taking the crossings won't tell us how many troops have slipped between the armies before they get there.
line.post-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.post-0.text: The liaison officers need to leave now. Give them both dispositions and keep a set on their frequency.
